idea-plugin.name: TS Costs
idea-plugin.description:
Find expensive TypeScript checks directly in your editor, including Vue single-file components.

  • Measured inline costs with source fingerprints to hide stale results.
  • Overview of elapsed time, compiler CPU, peak RSS and TypeScript memory.
  • Searchable hotspot and file rankings with explanations and Vue-generated code.
  • One-click Record: Nuxt type generation, fresh compiler trace, CPU profile and same-run Vue source maps.

Uses your installed JavaScript TypeScript 5/6 and vue-tsc. Native tsgo is not supported. Timings are inclusive compiler wall time. CPU and memory are process-wide, not per-line.

Open source (MIT). Profiles stay local; no telemetry or automatic uploads.

Documentation and source
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.3.0: Explain recorded operations and compared types, distinguish evidence from suggestions, and guide focused optimization experiments. 0.2.3: Copy and expand recorded snippets, toggle line wrapping, and read compact cost details with type-checking context. 0.2.2: Native syntax-highlighted, read-only source and generated-code previews with line numbers and soft wrapping. 0.2.1: Fix saving documents when recording from the tool-window button. 0.2: Aggregate metrics, CPU and memory, automatic Nuxt preparation, portable Record, generated-code explanations, searchable paginated views and project settings.
